items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Yeah, I played down there with Billy and you did.

ctx.x: I don't know, it seems like. They had two Olympia. I think so. They had the old Olympia and they had the young Olympia. I believe Ricard Alexis told us once that he started out in the young Olympia or something. That's right.

I don't know who was in the man's up there. I think Simon Morera, I think, was managing the young Olympia. Yeah, he was managing the young Olympia band. The bass player. That's right. One, two, one. See, one time, I know, Billy Moran had that band together. They had the Olympia band together. Yeah.

items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: What you had in the band with you then, him and whoever? Them Tatt. Tatt, old man granny, Billy, the piano player, Lil' Orange.

ctx.x: What band you had, Arnest, when a violin player, what's his name? Oh, Pete, not Pete, uh, Pete. I was playing with you, Tapper's friend. Oh, uh, uh, Dominguez.
Dominguez. Yeah, Paul Dominguez. Paul Dominguez, he worked with me too. What you had in the band with you then, him and whoever? Them Tatt. Tatt, old man granny, Billy, the piano player, Lil' Orange.
